question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The next move of the opponent was __anticipated __by the team.
solution:
The correct answer is **Predicted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anticipated **means To foresee or expect something to happen **(होनेवाला होना, अनुमान लगाना**)

 
 
• **Example Sentence:** The company anticipated a rise in sales after launching the new product.
